Horatio Alger Jr., Ragged Dick.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/horatio-alger-jr/ragged-dick

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Horatio Alger Jr., the author, died 1899.

First publication of the text used: 1868 (SE colophon: 'Ragged Dick was published in 1868 by Horatio Alger, Jr.'; Wikipedia, 'Ragged Dick': publisher A. K. Loring, publication date May 5, 1868, publication place United States).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1868, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States, before 1931, so the United States rule above settles the country of origin whatever the death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published in 1868 by Horatio Alger, Jr.; no other publication date given.
- Wikidata Q453251 (Horatio Alger Jr.), P570 = 1899-07-18
- Wikipedia, Ragged Dick (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ragged_Dick): publication date May 5, 1868, publication place United States
